stage: 4-3: diagnostic attribution and provisional applicability, not model refitting
status: Exploratory follow-up after viewing phase 4-2; not an independent validation or preregistration
model: Frozen S1 parameters and simulator from carryover_replay_v1
arrival_factor_status: Assumed sensitivity range, not measured admission uncertainty or a confidence interval
metrics: Original RMSE/MAE plus same-calendar-window errors, late-window errors and observed/predicted first sampled Waiting; no weighted J
token_alignment: At interval-ending snapshot, use logged tokens/s weighted by preceding snapshot interval; omit first snapshot of each window
departure_proxy: configured arrival rate minus slope(Running+Waiting); not measured completions and not a confirmed capacity

facility_mapping.input: Previously constructed K=1000 offered request streams only
facility_mapping.instance_allocation: For each service independently: ceil(mean facility offered rps / illustrative mean rate target)
facility_mapping.within_service_distribution: Equal fractional rate to all fixed instances, not explicit request routing
